sinopsis.es: Dos hombres se encuentran por última vez y deben decidir si expresan lo que han callado.
sinopsis.en: A celebration on the terrace. Memories of the first date, of the time when it seemed that their dreams did not match. Or maybe they did. Javi and Diego, will they dare to tell each other this time what they have not dared to until now? They may not have any more chances.
